findings.problem: Choice card 14 (Acts 13:31) comes right after choice card 13. No story card sets it up. The setup ("Paul says God raised Jesus from the dead, and for many days He was seen") is told only inside the question. So the resurrection in Acts 13:30, the turn the whole sermon hangs on, is never told on a story card. It shows up only as the False answer to card 13 and inside the question on card 14. A story card should tell that God raised Him and that He was seen for many days, before card 14 asks who saw Him.

rule.text: The setup for a choice is always on a story card.

findings.problem: The card quotes "I have made you a light for the Gentiles..." but says only that Paul and Barnabas "back it up with Scripture". It never says who the "I" is. Acts 13:47 presents it as what the Lord has commanded. Note when fixing: choice card 10 asks whether this is what the Lord commanded, so naming the speaker on card 9 must not give card 10 away. Card 10 may need a different question.

rule.text: Who's speaking. When he quotes someone speaking as "I," he says who it is first.

findings.problem: The card calls John "one of the crew". Acts 13:13 calls the group "Paul and his companions", and the passage before it (Acts 13:5) calls John their helper. Coming right after "They set sail", "one of the crew" can read as one of the ship's crew. It should call him what the text does, for example one of Paul's companions or their helper.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.
